description: RFC 6532 / EAI message: raw 8-bit UTF-8 in the From/To display names and a raw-UTF-8 Subject (no RFC 2047 encoded-words) carrying a zero-width space (U+200B) and a bidi override pair (U+202E/U+202C). Proves EAI headers reach Unicode sanitization directly, not only through the RFC 2047 decode path: the zero-width and bidi codepoints are stripped and both warnings fire.
